meta.name: google-agents-cli-adk-code
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to "write agent code", "build an agent with ADK", "add a tool", "create a callback", "define an agent", "use state management", or needs ADK (Agent Development Kit) Python API patterns and code examples. Part of the Google ADK skills suite. It provides a quick reference for agent types, tool definitions, orchestration patterns, callbacks, state management, and reference recipes to study. Do NOT use for scaffolding (use google-agents-cli-scaffold) or deployment (use google-agents-cli-deploy).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查阅 ADK 代码示例,照着实现智能体的功能、回调和状态管理。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在用 ADK 编写智能体时总想找现成代码示例。
copy.tagline_en: Reference ADK code samples to implement agent tools, callbacks, and state.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build ADK agents and often look for existing Python code examples.

howto.what: 用户问 ADK 代码怎么写时,Claude 会先核实项目已用 agents-cli 建好,再查询内置 recipe 索引,然后给出 Agent、工具、回调、编排、状态管理等的 Python 示例;脚手架和部署不在此技能处理范围。
howto.when: 当你提出 ADK 代码相关问题,例如写 agent 代码、构建 ADK agent、添加工具等,或需要 ADK Python API 示例时触发;若只是脚手架或部署需求则不会触发。

say.text: 怎么在 Python 里给 agent 添加一个自定义工具？
say.note: Claude 会给出对应的工具定义示例代码。

say.text: 我想定义一个带状态管理的 ADK agent,代码怎么写？
say.note: 会引用状态管理相关参考文档给出写法。

say.text: 怎么让两个 agent 串行执行?给我看个代码例子。
say.note: 会给 SequentialAgent 的编排示例。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to answer ADK Python API questions with code examples after verifying a scaffolded project and reading the recipe catalog. Covers agents, tools, callbacks, orchestrations, state; excludes scaffolding and deployment.
howto.when_en: Trigger when the user writes agent code, builds an ADK agent, adds a tool, etc., or needs ADK Python API examples. Not for scaffolding or deployment.

say_en.text: How do I add a custom tool to an agent in Python?
say_en.note: Claude will provide the matching tool-definition example.

say_en.text: I want an ADK agent with state management, how should I code it?
say_en.note: It will pull the state-management reference for you.

say_en.text: How can I run two agents sequentially? Show me a code example.
say_en.note: It shows a SequentialAgent orchestration sample.
